argv:
set -euo pipefail
work=${RUNNER_CHECKOUT:-/root/runner/checkout}
mkdir -p "$work"
python3 "$CAIRN_LAB_MOUNT_IN_TREE/cloud/install_tree.py" "$CAIRN_LAB_MOUNT_IN_TREE" "$work"
cd "$work"
source cloud/pod_env.sh
JOB_DIR=$CAIRN_LAB_OUT JOB_WORKDIR=$work exec bash cloud/job_runner.sh

env.JOB_CMD: mkdir -p experiments/cairn-runpod-queue-20261006/outputs && cd suite && cargo build --release --locked --example dreg_sweep --example f4_degree_bench 2>&1 | tail -n 4 && F4_F2_ECHELON_VERBOSE=1 ./target/release/examples/dreg_sweep > ../experiments/cairn-runpod-queue-20261006/outputs/dreg-sweep-auto.txt

note: Unconfined (sandbox none) on a Runpod pod, a container with no engine inside: cairn passes a GPU only to a job an engine runs, so the spec asks for none, and the job uses the pod's GPU directly.
